LABELED GAME MECHANICS ASSUMPTIONS
======================================================================
1. Harvest Additional Affixes: Modeled as 50% chance of 1 additional affix / 50% chance of 2 additional affixes (PoE 4-mod rare cluster jewel affix distribution).
2. Base Self-Fracture Model: Approximate Alteration/Augmentation/Regal/Bench preparation + Fracturing Orb (25% hit rate).
3. Market Purchase Prices: Any unsupplied market price is reported as not supplied / unavailable rather than inferred.
4. Allflame Crafting: Stateful Intangibility stacking remains deferred and disabled.
